fidelity_transitions.scope: Descriptive same-provider judge contrasts against evidence-valid B0 votes in the same mode. Baseline fail does not distinguish inherited from additional errors; missing/conflicting/uncertain baselines do not prove new damage. Reused requests, multiple judges and variants are not independent samples. Partial cells can supply a valid vote; this does not change primary acceptance.
